idea-plugin.name: Sparkle Particles for Minecraft Mods
idea-plugin.description:
Particle systems for Minecraft mods (Forge, NeoForge, Fabric): a visual editor with templates and a live 3D preview, and a small Java runtime that plays them in the game.

  • New particle system (File | New, or Tools | Sparkle): pick a template (Sparks, Beam, Fountain, Bounce, Ribbon, Empty). The file goes to src/main/resources/assets/<mod id>/sparkle/<name>.json.
  • Visual editor for every assets/<namespace>/sparkle/*.json file: emitters, modules, user parameters and an animated 3D preview. The JSON text is one click away, with completion and validation. Undo, redo and save work as for any file.
  • Install the runtime in the mod: the loader, the Minecraft version, the mod id and the package are found, and a file changed by hand is never replaced without asking.
  • Copy the code that plays the system: Sparkle.play(level, "mymod:fire", x, y, z);

The same editor and the same runtime as the Sparkle extension for VS Code.
